# Introduction

# Methods
## Load necessary libraries
```{r load_libraries}
library(leaflet)
```

## Load anti-shipping activity messages
Data from http://msi.nga.mil/NGAPortal/MSI.portal?_nfpb=true&_pageLabel=msi_portal_page_65
```{r load_data, results='hide',error=FALSE,message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
# Read in EEZ data
# Marine Regions V9
eez <- read_sf(dsn = "../raw_data/World_EEZ_v9_20161021_LR", layer = "eez_lr", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

## load anti-shipping data
## Process dates, and filter out anything before 2010
# Join to eez data to figure out which eez each attack happens in
ASAM <- read_sf(dsn = "../raw_data/ASAM_shp", layer = "ASAM 20 MAR 18", stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(Date = as_date(DateOfOcc),
         Year = year(Date)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-DateOfOcc) %>%
  filter(Year > 2010 & Year < 2018) %>%
  `st_crs<-`(st_crs(eez)) %>%
  st_join(eez, join = st_intersects) %>%
  mutate(attack_eez = ifelse(is.na(ISO_Ter1),"High Seas",as.character(ISO_Ter1)))

# Define cell size for hot spot map
cell_size <- 5 #degrees
one_over_cellsize = 1/cell_size

ASAM <- do.call(rbind, st_geometry(ASAM)) %>% 
  as_tibble() %>% 
  cbind(ASAM$Year,
        ASAM$Date,
        ASAM$Aggressor,
        ASAM$Victim,
        ASAM$attack_eez) %>%
  setNames(c("lon","lat","year","date","aggressor","victim","attack_eez")) %>%
  mutate(lon_bin = floor(lon*one_over_cellsize)/one_over_cellsize,
         lat_bin = floor(lat*one_over_cellsize)/one_over_cellsize) 

# Group by bins, summarize, and add hotspot id
ASAM_binned <- ASAM %>%
  group_by(year,lon_bin,lat_bin) %>%
  summarize(number_attacks = n()) %>%
  ungroup()

hotspots <- distinct(ASAM_binned %>% dplyr::select(lon_bin,lat_bin)) %>%
  mutate(hotspot_id = 1:n())


ASAM_binned <- ASAM_binned %>%
  left_join(hotspots, by = c("lat_bin","lon_bin"))

ASAM <- ASAM %>%
  left_join(ASAM_binned %>%
              dplyr::select(year,lon_bin,lat_bin,hotspot_id),by = c("year", "lon_bin", "lat_bin")) %>%
  dplyr::select(date,year,lat,lon,lat_bin,lon_bin,hotspot_id,aggressor,victim,attack_eez)


write_csv(ASAM,"../processed_data/attacks.csv")

date_range <- seq(ymd('2011-01-01'),ymd('2017-12-31'), by = '1 day')
```

``` {r expanding_asam}
# Create expanded attack dataframe for every hotspot and date combination
# To create summary stats for each combination
# Will then join this to vessel track info in big query
expanded_asam <- expand.grid(date = date_range,
                             hotspot_id = hotspots$hotspot_id) %>%
  left_join(hotspots,by="hotspot_id") %>%
  left_join(ASAM %>%
              dplyr::select(date,
                            lon_bin,
                            lat_bin,
                            attack_eez) %>%
              group_by(date,lon_bin,lat_bin) %>%
              summarize(number_attacks = n()),by=c("date","lon_bin","lat_bin")) %>%
  mutate(number_attacks = ifelse(is.na(number_attacks),0,number_attacks),
         attacks_last_30_days = rollapplyr(number_attacks, width = 30, FUN = sum, na.rm=TRUE, partial = TRUE),
         attacks_last_60_days = rollapplyr(number_attacks, width = 60, FUN = sum, na.rm=TRUE, partial = TRUE),
         attacks_last_90_days = rollapplyr(number_attacks, width = 90, FUN = sum, na.rm=TRUE, partial = TRUE),
         attacks_last_180_days = rollapplyr(number_attacks, width = 180, FUN = sum, na.rm=TRUE, partial = TRUE),
         attacks_last_365_days = rollapplyr(number_attacks, width = 365, FUN = sum, na.rm=TRUE, partial = TRUE)) %>%
  # Calculate elapsed time since last attack
  # See https://stackoverflow.com/questions/26553638/calculate-elapsed-time-since-last-event/26554441
  group_by(hotspot_id) %>%
  mutate(tmpG = cumsum(c(FALSE, as.logical(diff(number_attacks))))) %>%
  mutate(tmp_a = c(1, diff(date)) * !number_attacks) %>%
  group_by(hotspot_id,tmpG) %>%
  mutate(days_since_attack = ifelse(tmpG == 0, NA, cumsum(tmp_a)),
         is_current_hotspot = ifelse(is.na(days_since_attack), NA, 1)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-c(tmp_a, tmpG, number_attacks))

# Push expanded table to big query
# Only run if necessary
```

## Global attack visualization
```{r attack_histogram}
ASAM %>%
  group_by(attack_eez) %>%
  summarize(n = n()) %>%
  filter(n > 10) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=reorder(attack_eez,-n),y=n)) +
           geom_histogram(stat="identity") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  xlab("Country") +
  ylab("Number of attacks\n2010 - 2018")
```

```{r interactive_map}
  dplyr::select(lon_bin, lat_bin,number_attacks)

attack_raster <-  rasterFromXYZ(attack_raster, crs = st_crs(eez)$proj4string)
```

```{r attack_raster}



# Projection
proj <- "+proj=robin +lon_0=0 +x_0=0 +y_0=0 +ellps=WGS84 +datum=WGS84"

# Download and read in world land data
# download.file(url="http://www.naturalearthdata.com/http//www.naturalearthdata.com/download/110m/physical/ne_110m_land.zip", "ne_110m_land.zip", "auto")
# unzip("ne_110m_land.zip")
# file.remove("ne_110m_land.zip")

world.land <- read_sf(dsn = "../raw_data/ne_110m_land", layer = "ne_110m_land", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

attack_lat_limits <- c(min(ASAM_binned$lat_bin) - 5, max(ASAM_binned$lat_bin) + 5)
attack_lon_limits <- c(min(ASAM_binned$lon_bin) - 5, max(ASAM_binned$lon_bin) + 5)

# Make attack plot for every year
p_all_years <-  ggplot() +  
    geom_tile(data = ASAM_binned,
                aes(x = lon_bin, y = lat_bin, fill=number_attacks)) + 
    scale_fill_viridis(na.value="white",name="Number of Attacks",option = "C", direction = -1, end = 0.95) +
            geom_sf(data = world.land,
            fill = "lightgrey",
            lwd = 0) +
    theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.title.x=element_blank(),
        axis.text.x=element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x=element_blank(),
        axis.title.y=element_blank(),
        axis.text.y=element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y=element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "grey50"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "grey50"),
        strip.background =element_rect(fill="white"),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = 'grey50'))

p_by_year <- p_all_years + 
    facet_wrap(~year, ncol = 2) +
      guides(fill = guide_colourbar(barheight = 3.25, barwidth = 3.25)) +
  theme(legend.position = c(1, 0), 
        legend.justification = c(1, 0)) +
      ylim(attack_lat_limits) +
    xlim(attack_lon_limits)
p_all_years
p_by_year
```
